name_reason: Name follows the data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> rule (domain=battle, a core battle table). Descriptor accurately reflects use (summon-spell main animation, color rotation counter) and data type (counter). No Ghidra address residue: 0x53FE1 has no matching hex suffix. The scalar carries no array dimension in its name, consistent with sibling counters in the same file (data_fd2_battle_summon_anim_variant_a_color_rotation_counter mod-10, variant_b/variant_d likewise) -- the mod-12 wrap is a property of the value, not a dimension to encode. uint8 element type is correct (byte-wide store/INC + MOVZX read).
purpose: Mod-12 counter that drives per-color row-offset cycling for the main 12-slot summon-spell animation; on a slot wrap it is copied into that slot's color index.
logic_summary: Sole user fd2_tick_summon_spell_main_animation_state (@0x26795, dispatch-table entry #3). INIT (state_code 0) seeds it to 12 (MOV [0x53FE1],BL with BL=loop count 12 at 0x26828). During a slot's frame-0xB rotation (TICK states 2/5/8, even-frame gate) it is INC'd (0x2698C), read zero-extended (MOVZX at 0x26992), reduced mod 12 via IDIV ESI(=0xC) at 0x269A3, stored back (0x269A5), then copied into that slot's color index (data_fd2_battle_summon_main_anim_12slot_color_idx_array at 0x269AE). Rotation is skipped while the terminate flag is set.
element_semantics: Single unsigned byte; running mod-12 color-rotation cursor in 0..11 (seeded to 12 at INIT, then kept in 0..11 by IDIV-by-12 remainder). Picks the next per-color row-offset/sprite group when a slot wraps.
notes: Verified against disassembly of fd2_tick_summon_spell_main_animation_state: write@0x26828 (INIT seed, BL=12), INC@0x2698C, MOVZX read@0x26992, mod-12 store@0x269A5 (IDIV by 0xC), copy-to-color-idx@0x269AE. xrefs_to all four sites lie in the single user function -> not const (game writes). Memory @0x53FE1 is all 0x00 (zero-bss runtime scratch). Ghidra datatype undefined1 (len=1) == src uint8. src comment block (anisummn.c lines 867-879) and Ghidra plate are both already accurate and mutually consistent; no edit needed to either.
